About

Movie Value Ledger

A small, opinionated framework for thinking about cinema through value: national impact, business mechanics, community identity, and the personal trade-off of time and money.

What this is

The project is designed to turn movie conversations into a structured, shareable experience. It keeps the UI minimal, the language sharp, and the social loop obvious.
